clips.title: The story
paras: Ghost Hair Thread is an errand undertaken for the fortune-teller Madame Eva in Darkshire. In order to gather the ghost hair she needs to spin Ghost Hair Thread, travelers are sent south to seek out Blind Mary, a tormented spirit who dwells in an abandoned farmhouse. By presenting her with an ethereal comb, one can gather the necessary strands from her ghostly tresses.

Madame Eva of Darkshire requires specialized, otherworldly materials to spin Ghost Hair Thread for Abercrombie. Standard threads of linen and wool will not suffice for the rituals of Duskwood; instead, she requires ethereal strands harvested directly from a spirit. To secure this macabre component without violence, Eva provides a delicate Spectral Comb capable of passing through the veil of death to gather loose spectral hair.

South of Darkshire, tucked away in the shadowy hills, lies an abandoned farmstead haunted by the wailing apparition known as Blind Mary. Consumed by self-loathing, the spirit constantly laments her hideous appearance and screams at intruders to avert their eyes, having torn out her own eyes in anguish over what she has become. The gift of the Spectral Comb offers her a fleeting moment of comfort, coaxing her to groom her ghostly hair despite her unending torment.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: There is a poor, sad spirit, Blind Mary, who haunts an old farm house in the hills south of Darkshire.
Here, take this Spectral Comb and ask Blind Mary to comb her hair. Then bring back the comb and I will glean from it the Ghost Hair I'll need for the thread.
And take care, for dark things now lurk near that house...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Oh please, don't look at me! I tore out these eyes with my own hands, but I can still feel your gaze!
I'm hideous! Hideous! Please, look away!!

clips.title: Completion
paras: What is this? A comb? It's lovely! And it glides through my hair as if it weren't the stiff, stringy horror that it is.
Oh, if only I had a mirror...
